title: NFL Alum Kevin Faulk's Daughter Dies 4 Years After Her Younger Sister | E! News
text:
Former New England Patriots player Kevin Faulk’s daughter, Tanasha Faulk, died unexpectedly at the age of 30. In an online obituary, the Faulk family penned a heartfelt tribute, writing, “Family was the center of Tanasha’s world. Especially her three daughters, who were the greatest blessings of her life. Being their mother brought her so much joy, and she was immensely proud watching them grow and learn.” Tanasha is survived by her siblings Tionne, Tavion, and Kevin Faulk III, along with her partner, Isaac Louis, and her three kids. This devastating news comes just four years after Kevin and his wife, Latisha Faulk, suffered another tragic loss when their daughter Kevione Faulk died at the age of 19 while working at Louisiana State University alongside the NFL player.
